name: Adrenaline Rush
body:
At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter the blood knight learns new ways to utilize their combat fervor, and make the battlefield truly their domain. The DC of any adrenaline rush is equal to 10 + 1/2 blood knight level + the blood knight’s Charisma modifier. Unless specifically noted, an adrenaline rush cannot be selected more than once.

Armored Tackle (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 6th level
Description: Blood knights can spend a full-round action to make a charge against a foe and at the end of the charge they make a Slam natural attack which deals damage based on their armor being worn (1d6 for light armor, 1d8 for medium armor, and 1d10 for heavy armor). This slam attack adds 1.5x their Strength modifier to damage, and on a successful hit they must make a Reflex save or fall prone. Blood knights add armor spikes as bonus damage if they have them. They cannot use this while unarmored, and the blood knight must have at least 1 point of combat fervor to use this ability.

Armor Training (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 9th level
Description: So long as the blood knight possesses at least 1 point of combat fervor, they are treated as having Armor Training as a fighter of their level with the suit of armor they’re wearing. Blood knight levels and fighter levels stack for determining the total rank of Armor Training they’d possess from this ability.

Aura of Hemorrhaging (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 6th level
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor, enemies within 10 feet take a -2 penalty on saving throws against effects which would cause bleed and -2 to AC against attacks which would inflict bleed. At 12th level the penalty becomes -4 and the radius increases to 20 feet.

Blood Bath (Ex)
Prerequisites: None
Description: Blood knights can spend 1 point of combat fervor to recover hit points as if they had cast a cure light wounds spell onto themselves, using their blood knight level as their caster level. At 6th level this is cure moderate wounds, at 9th level this is cure serious wounds, at 12th level this is cure critical wounds, and finally at 15th level this is treated as casting heal. If the blood knight is instead healed by negative energy, this mimics the inflict variants and harm at 15th level.

Blood Craft (Su)
Prerequisites: Craft (alchemy) 3 ranks
Description: Blood knights can choose to utilize their blood in place of material components, suffering 1 HP damage for every 100 gp worth of materials being substituted out. Diamond dust and other valuable materials worth 1,000 gp or more per use instead deal 1 Constitution damage per 1,000 gp.

Bloody Footprints (Su)
Prerequisites: None
Description: Blood knights can spend 1 point of combat fervor to grant themselves +10 feet to their land-based movement speed, so long as they step over the corpse of a foe at any point during their movement. At 9th level, they can alternatively spend 3 points of combat fervor to cause all corpses within 30 feet to explode into a gory mess.

Blood in the Water (Ex)
Prerequisites: None
Description: Blood knights receive a +2 bonus to Perception checks to locate creatures suffering from bleed damage, and a +2 bonus to Survival checks to track bleeding creatures. At 9th level the blood knight instead receives the benefits of the Blood Scent spell but as a constant natural ability. They do receive the morale bonus to hit without being an Orc or under a rage effect.

Blood Manipulation (Su)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 9th level
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor, they are immune to injury-based poisons. They receive a +4 bonus to Fortitude saves against inhaled poisons and diseases.

Challenger’s Fury (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 6th level
Description: When a target of the blood knight’s duelist’s challenge successfully deals damage to the blood knight with a melee attack, the blood knight can spend 1 point of combat fervor as an immediate action to make a single melee attack against that target. This attack is made at the blood knight’s highest base attack bonus.

Combat Expert (Ex)
Prerequisites: None
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor, they are treated as possessing combat expertise as a bonus feat, even if they don’t meet the prerequisites. They are treated as possessing the feat for the purposes of picking feats that require it as a prerequisite as well, but those feats are only able to be used when they have at least 1 point of combat fervor.

Fisticuffs (Ex)
Prerequisites: None
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor, they receive improved unarmed strike as a bonus feat, even if they don’t meet the prerequisites. They are treated as possessing the feat for the purposes of picking feats that require it as a prerequisite as well, but those feats are only able to be used when they have at least 1 point of combat fervor. If they already possess improved unarmed strike, their unarmed strikes deal damage as per a monk equal to blood knight level – 4 (minimum of 1).

Flesh Knit (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 9th level
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor they gain fast healing 1. They can spend combat fervor to instead increase this up to a maximum of fast healing 10. This increase to fast healing lasts 10 minutes per blood knight level.

Heavy Metal Armor (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 15th level, armor training, armored tackle
Description: The blood knight deals damage with their armored tackle’s slam attack as if they were two size categories larger. They’re also capable of using this slam attack as a secondary attack alongside their manufactured weapons and/or natural attacks. When used in this way, they deal their full Strength modifier for damage instead of the 1.5x Strength when charging.

Pit Fighter’s Instinct (Ex)
Prerequisites: None
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor, they gain a +2 insight bonus on initiative checks. At 6th level, the blood knight is also treated as having uncanny dodge. At 9th level they are treated as having improved uncanny dodge. Both of these benefits disappear if the initiative bonus would disappear.

Rending Blow (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 15th level
Description: When the blood knight hits a target that is already suffering from bleed damage, they can spend 1 point of combat fervor as a free action to worsen any bleed they’re already affected by. For 1 minute the bleed the target is being affected by cannot be healed through natural healing and magical healing must be sufficiently strong either; greater restoration and similar spells of 7th level or higher as well as wish and miracle can both achieve this.

Scarred Resilience (Ex)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 12th level, still standing class feature
Description: While the blood knight has at least 1 point of combat fervor the blood knight receives natural armor (or increases if they already possess it) by an amount equal to their Charisma modifier. If their current hit points are 0 or lower they also receive DR/- equal to their Charisma modifier (maximum of 5/-). This DR/- is lost at the beginning of their turn if they are above 0 hit points.

Vitae Surge (Su)
Prerequisites: Blood knight 9th level
Description: The blood knight can spend 3 points of combat fervor as an immediate action to grant themselves 2d10 + blood knight level as temporary hit points. These temporary hit points increase by +1d10 at 12th level and every 3 levels thereafter (to a maximum of 5d10 at 18th level).
